_comment: Which covenant a grant runs, by the fingerprint its manifest already carries. A version is NOT a fingerprint: templateFingerprint is blake2b over the full baseline bytecode, and the baked parameters (maxProofDepth, maxFee) are in that bytecode — so the same source compiled at a different depth is a different fingerprint under the same version. Each entry therefore names its template FILE, and ops/check-versions.mjs re-derives the fingerprint from it rather than trusting this line. An entry that stops re-deriving is an entry that has been edited by hand, which is the only failure this file can have. A grant whose fingerprint is not here is rendered as its bare fingerprint: that is the honest display of a template nobody has accounted for, and not an error.
_source: The version column agrees with the table in GUARANTEES.md, and check-versions.mjs compares the two so the prose and the data cannot drift.

versions.summary: epoch hole, no expiry, exits could burn
versions.note: Two of the six recorded vulnerabilities were live in this one. Kept because a grant issued under a template is addressable only through that template.

No archived template file. v2 was overwritten before archiving became the habit, so this entry is from GUARANTEES.md rather than re-derived — and check-versions.mjs says so out loud rather than passing it quietly. No grant in this repo runs it.
Archived BEFORE v4 overwrote covenant-template.json, which is the only order that works: the live v3 grant is addressable only through this file, and it is the sole copy.
What every grant issued since 15 September runs. Delegation narrows to a subtree of the parent's allowlist and proves it; a settled child returns its reserve. Unaudited by a third party.

versions.summary: delegate2 — two children in one transaction
versions.note: v4 plus one additive entrypoint and nothing else changed. delegate is untouched and still creates one child, because fanout(to = N) fixes the authorised output count exactly. Its suite passes — two accepted baselines, eight refused flips, and both children settle through v4's reabsorb unchanged — and it is NOT audited, so a grant under it is a demonstration rather than a place to put money. covenant/V5.md is the plan and the evidence.
